title: Compliance obligation
description: One entry of the venture's obligations register, its compliance calendar (ISO 37301:2021 clause 4.5, compliance obligations; APQC 11.2.2.2, identify applicable requirements), at legal/obligations/<id>.json (route legal/obligations/[id]): one duty the venture must meet by a date, such as a franchise tax, an annual report, a Form D, an 83(b) election, a licence renewal or a contract's notice date, with who imposes it, who owns it and what proves it was met. The agent prepares; a person files, signs and pays. The risk-and-compliance function owns it, and only the risk-and-compliance agent (role risk-and-compliance-agent) or a person writes it (writer function in packages/naive/src/records/data-model.json).

id.description: The obligation's id, the file name without .json

authority.description: Who imposes it: a regulator, a tax authority, a court or a counterparty

basis.description: The law, rule or contract clause it comes from, cited

due_date.description: The next date it must be met

prep_days.description: Days it takes to prepare. The calendar raises it at least twice this many days before the due date

owner.description: The person who files, signs or pays, by people record id or role

cure.description: What a miss costs: curable, a late fee, or not curable at all (a missed 83(b) window)

evidence.description: What proves it was met: a filing receipt, a proof of mailing or an evidence record
